mapper.select: SELECT attendance_id, store_id, store_staff_id, shift_id, work_date, clock_in_at, clock_out_at, break_start_at, break_end_at, total_break_minutes, net_work_minutes, night_work_minutes, overtime_minutes, clock_in_method, attendance_status FROM attendance WHERE store_staff_id = #{storeStaffId} AND attendance_status IN ('WORKING', 'ON_BREAK') ORDER BY attendance_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT attendance_id, store_id, store_staff_id, shift_id, work_date, clock_in_at, clock_out_at, break_start_at, break_end_at, total_break_minutes, net_work_minutes, night_work_minutes, overtime_minutes, clock_in_method, attendance_status FROM attendance WHERE attendance_id = #{attendanceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance ( store_id, store_staff_id, shift_id, work_date, clock_in_at, clock_out_at, break_start_at, break_end_at, total_break_minutes, net_work_minutes, night_work_minutes, overtime_minutes, clock_in_method, attendance_status ) VALUES ( #{storeId}, #{storeStaffId}, #{shiftId}, #{workDate}, #{clockInAt}, #{clockOutAt}, #{breakStartAt}, #{breakEndAt}, #{totalBreakMinutes}, #{netWorkMinutes}, #{nightWorkMinutes}, #{overtimeMinutes}, #{clockInMethod}, #{attendanceStatus} )
mapper.update: UPDATE attendance SET clock_out_at = #{clockOutAt}, break_start_at = #{breakStartAt}, break_end_at = #{breakEndAt}, total_break_minutes = #{totalBreakMinutes}, net_work_minutes = #{netWorkMinutes}, night_work_minutes = #{nightWorkMinutes}, overtime_minutes = #{overtimeMinutes}, attendance_status = #{attendanceStatus}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE attendance_id = #{attendanceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance_break ( attendance_id, break_start_at, break_end_at, duration_minutes ) VALUES ( #{attendanceId}, #{breakStartAt}, #{breakEndAt}, #{durationMinutes} )
mapper.select: SELECT attendance_break_id, attendance_id, break_start_at, break_end_at, duration_minutes FROM attendance_break WHERE attendance_id = #{attendanceId} ORDER BY break_start_at ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM payroll WHERE store_staff_id = #{storeStaffId} AND #{workDate} >= range_start_date AND #{workDate} <= range_end_date AND payroll_status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'PAID')
SELECT store_staff_id FROM store_staff WHERE store_staff_id = #{storeStaffId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT attendance_id, store_id, store_staff_id, shift_id, work_date, clock_in_at, clock_out_at, total_break_minutes, net_work_minutes, night_work_minutes, overtime_minutes, clock_in_method, attendance_status FROM attendance WHERE store_staff_id = #{storeStaffId} AND work_date >= #{startDate} AND work_date <= #{endDate} AND attendance_status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY work_date ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance_mod_request ( attendance_id, store_id, store_staff_id, work_date, before_clock_in_at, before_clock_out_at, before_break_minutes, requested_clock_in_at, requested_clock_out_at, requested_break_minutes, reason, approval_status ) VALUES ( #{attendanceId}, #{storeId}, #{storeStaffId}, #{workDate}, #{beforeClockInAt}, #{beforeClockOutAt}, #{beforeBreakMinutes}, #{requestedClockInAt}, #{requestedClockOutAt}, #{requestedBreakMinutes}, #{reason}, 'PENDING' )
INSERT INTO attendance_mod_break ( mod_request_id, break_set_type, break_start_at, break_end_at, duration_minutes ) VALUES ( #{modRequestId}, #{breakSetType}, #{startAt}, #{endAt}, #{duration} )
mapper.select: SELECT r.mod_request_id, r.attendance_id, r.store_id, r.store_staff_id, m.full_name AS staff_name, r.work_date, r.before_clock_in_at, r.before_clock_out_at, r.before_break_minutes, r.requested_clock_in_at, r.requested_clock_out_at, r.requested_break_minutes, r.reason, r.approval_status, r.reject_reason, r.created_at FROM attendance_mod_request r JOIN store_staff ss ON r.store_staff_id = ss.store_staff_id JOIN member m ON ss.member_id = m.member_id WHERE r.mod_request_id = #{modRequestId}

SELECT mod_break_id AS attendance_break_id, mod_request_id AS attendance_id, break_start_at, break_end_at, duration_minutes FROM attendance_mod_break WHERE mod_request_id = #{modRequestId} AND break_set_type = #{breakSetType} ORDER BY break_start_at ASC
